description_en: Modifies the name, description, version information, and associated application adapters of an image
description_zh: 修改镜像名称、描述、版本信息及关联的应用适配
kebab_example: aliyun appstream-center update-image --image-id 'imgc-bp1example****' --image-name OfficeImage_202611 --description '更新办公软件及基础配置' --adaptor-id-list '["adt-bp1example****"]' --biz-language zh-CN --version-id 'iv-bp1example****' --distro 'Ubuntu 22.04 64位' --version-name '办公环境-202611' --api-version 2021-09-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateImage

parameters.help_en: The ID of the image to be modified. You must provide at least one of ImageId and VersionId. If both are provided, they must belong to the same image
parameters.help_zh: 待修改的镜像 ID。与 VersionId 至少提供一个；同时提供时必须属于同一镜像
parameters.name: image_id

parameters.help_en: The new name of the image. Specify this parameter only when you need to update the name
parameters.help_zh: 修改后的镜像名称。仅在需要更新名称时填写
parameters.name: image_name

parameters.example: 更新办公软件及基础配置
parameters.help_en: The updated description of the image
parameters.help_zh: 修改后的镜像用途说明
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The complete list of application adapter IDs for the selected image version. A maximum of 100 items are supported. When a non-empty list is passed, it must include the adapters that you still want to retain. Omitting this parameter or passing an empty list does not clear the existing associations
parameters.help_zh: 所选镜像版本的完整应用适配 ID 列表，最多 100 项。传入非空列表时，应包含仍需保留的适配；省略或空列表不会清空原有关联
parameters.name: adaptor_id_list

parameters.help_en:
The language of the image. Valid values:

zh-CN: Simplified Chinese.
zh-HK: Traditional Chinese (Hong Kong).
en-US: English.
ja-JP: Japanese.
CN: A compatible value for Simplified Chinese.
EN: A compatible value for English.
JP: A compatible value for Japanese.
CN-HK: A compatible value for Traditional Chinese (Hong Kong)
parameters.help_zh:
镜像语言。可选值：

zh-CN：简体中文。
zh-HK：繁体中文（香港）。
en-US：英语。
ja-JP：日语。
CN：简体中文的兼容取值。
EN：英语的兼容取值。
JP：日语的兼容取值。
CN-HK：繁体中文（香港）的兼容取值
parameters.name: language

parameters.help_en: The ID of the image version to be modified. If this parameter is omitted, the current effective version of the image specified by ImageId is used. You must provide at least one of ImageId and VersionId
parameters.help_zh: 待修改的镜像版本 ID。省略时按 ImageId 对应镜像的当前生效版本处理；与 ImageId 至少提供一个
parameters.name: version_id

parameters.help_en: The operating system distribution information of the image. This must be consistent with the actual operating system distribution of the image
parameters.help_zh: 镜像操作系统发行版信息。应与该镜像的实际操作系统发行版一致
parameters.name: distro

parameters.help_en: The new display name of the image version
parameters.help_zh: 修改后的镜像版本显示名称
parameters.name: version_name

schema.description_en: The response of the API call
schema.description_zh: 本次 API 调用的响应结果

Code.description_en: The error code. This field is returned when the request fails. A successful response may not contain this field
Code.description_zh: 错误码。请求失败时返回；成功响应可能不包含该字段

Data.description_en: Indicates whether the operation was processed successfully. A value of true indicates that the operation was successful
Data.description_zh: 本次操作是否处理成功。true 表示操作成功

Message.description_en: The error or result message. This field describes the cause when a request fails. A successful response may not contain this field
Message.description_zh: 错误或结果提示。请求失败时用于说明原因，成功响应可能不包含该字段

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request. You can provide this value when you troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，排查问题时可提供该值

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was processed successfully. A value of true indicates that the request was processed successfully. For asynchronous tasks, you must query the task status separately to check whether the task is completed
Success.description_zh: 请求是否处理成功。true 表示本次请求处理成功；异步任务是否完成须另外查询任务状态
